guard_configuration.actionless_rule: not_installed_by_default; if a batch enables it, it must be declared in the manifest and it must stay inert on the compliant arms

criteria.independent_recomputation: the batch audit must recompute all three from the recorded first_role_trace: coverage (each source at least once) decides the quality side together with the frozen r8 judge; repeats and same-work are recorded, never gated
criteria.errors_rule: errors non-empty means the numbers must not be quoted as a saving

request_cap.on_cap: stop immediately, keep the partial directory, continue under a NEW id with --resume; a partial grid is never a complete grid
abort_conditions: a guard firing on a non-plugin arm (only if a guard is declared enabled)

cost_estimate.basis: measured tokens per call from the r20 acquisition batch, measured hit share 68.58%, official input prices, the stated output stand-in
cost_estimate.note: cache changes dollars only; the acceptance line is complete provider tokens

acceptance.quality: frozen r8 judge per task (strict and semantic not below baseline) AND CRIT_R20_COVERAGE satisfied on every unit; repeats are reported, never gated
acceptance.cost: paired complete provider tokens positive on the majority and in the batch mean; every repeat, remedy and guard request charged in full; cache changes dollars only
acceptance.errors_rule: audit errors non-empty means the numbers must not be quoted as a saving

attribution.required_sentence: 在装上本轮控制器配置的主机配置下（本族不装顺序/重复守卫）

bound_gate.gate_3: PASS: every per-task safe candidate is at or above the 3% cost gate and non-empty

not_run: this draft is reported for review; no paid pilot is started
not_retroactive: r15, r16 and r17 keep their exact-order criterion, recorded failures and scores
